page_desc: Configure the terminal limit and enable or disable all registers for this branch.
settings_card_desc: Control access and terminal quota for this branch.
are_terminals_enabled_hint: When disabled, every register for this branch is locked.
max_terminals_hint: Maximum number of POS registers allowed in this branch.
confirm_deactivate_desc: This will temporarily disable every register in the branch. Users won't be able to operate until re-enabled.
registers_list_desc: Current list of assigned registers. They respect the allowed maximum.
empty_desc: Create new terminals from Settings > Registers.
branch_not_found_desc: Could not load the branch information. Check the URL or go back to the list.
